definitions.checkpoint_states: Distinct saved epoch deltas per fit, deduplicated when best_seen/best_unseen/last select the same epoch. Counts do not equal total trained epochs.
definitions.failures: Zero failures/unclosed units in these accepted full-gate ledgers does not establish zero failures or zero unrecorded work throughout the rental.
definitions.fit_seconds: Host perf_counter interval covering CUDA cache/reset plus fit_dual: model/base loading and hashes, uncached waveform preprocessing, all 15 training epochs and both validations, checkpoint creation and fsync, selected/last inference, fresh-model disk reload and all replay predictions. Excludes subsequent predictions/history/receipt serialization, DONE sealing and runner final verification. Not GPU busy time, rental time or a bill.
definitions.observed_ledger_interval: Elapsed first unit_start to last unit_done event, including gaps between batches and any delayed recovery event; not a sum of GPU work and not the complete rental interval.
definitions.optimizer_updates_attempted: Sum of history.optimizer_steps, including AMP-skipped minibatches. Skips are inferred from a GradScaler scale decrease; not-skipped = attempted minus these recorded skips.
definitions.payload_bytes: Current sizes of each unit checkpoint, predictions, history, receipt and DONE; excludes base model, ledger, transfer archives, audit files, raw audio and features.
definitions.peak_cuda_allocated_bytes: torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated after per-fit reset; not reserved memory, whole-process nvidia-smi usage or total board memory.

ledger_wall_definition: unit_done ISO timestamp minus unit_start; includes per-unit wrapping/sealing but not initial shared gate or gaps between units; wall clock, not monotonic measurement
history_timing_definition: No epoch/train/evaluation/save timing fields were recorded. Epoch loss/step records cannot recover those durations.

transfer.scope: four parallel SSH tar streams per completed 8-fit batch; transfer totals overlap training, not additive rental hours; excludes initial audio/model/environment uploads

coverage_crosscheck.scope: Different prior speaker-coverage experiment; descriptive support only, not an ablation of dual validation

tentative_240_fit_scenario.assumptions: same RTX5090 observed environment, 576 fit clips, batch16, 15 epochs, top4+head; future fixed cfg3/last-only implementation not benchmarked
tentative_240_fit_scenario.caveat: Storage proxy assumes unchanged FP32 epoch-delta architecture/serialization; new metadata/class head/optimizer saving can alter it. Runtime projections are historical scaling scenarios, not promised rental duration or a price quote.
